final_resume.summary: Backend engineer with 1+ year of professional experience building scalable Java and Spring Boot microservices.

bullets: Reduced p95 latency of the settlement API from 800 ms to 350 ms by implementing Redis caching, improving system performance for high-throughput payment processing.
Architected and deployed 4 Spring Boot microservices to replace a monolithic payouts module, enabling independent scaling and faster feature delivery.
Mentored 2 junior engineers and conducted code reviews across 2-week Agile sprints, ensuring code quality and knowledge sharing.
Automated nightly reconciliation reports using Java batch processing, saving the operations team 6 hours per week.

profile_improvement_tips: Learn and build a project in Python or JavaScript to match the JD's language requirements; both are widely used in Google Cloud infrastructure and backend services.
Gain hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, or Firestore; consider earning a GCP Associate Cloud Engineer certification.
Deepen system design knowledge by studying distributed systems patterns (eventual consistency, sharding, replication) and documenting a design for a high-scale service you have built.
final_resume.growth_note: You have strong Java and microservices fundamentals, but the JD lists 5 programming languages and you have only Java. GCP is not mentioned in your profile. Consider gaining Python or JavaScript proficiency and GCP hands-on experience to be a competitive candidate for this role.
